1qisaa.source: Hand-curated seed + PD facsimile diplomatic excerpts

initial_units.original: קול קורא במדבר פנו דרך יהוה ישרו בערבה מסלה לאלהינו
initial_units.original_label: Hebrew consonantal text of this line (Masoretic vocalization for display; scroll lacks full pointing)
initial_units.original_source: Standard Isaiah 40:3 consonants; compare 1QIsaᵃ plate (Leon Levy / DJD X)
initial_units.english: A voice calls, "In the wilderness, prepare the way of Yahweh! Make a level highway in the desert for our God."
initial_units.english_source: World English Bible (PD), adapted to match shown Hebrew locus

initial_units.original: קול אמר קרא ואמר מה יקרא כל הבשר חציר וכל חסדו כציץ השדה יבש חציר נבל ציץ נבל כי רוח יהוה נשבה בו אכן חציר העם
initial_units.original_label: Excerpt from column XL (Isaiah 40) — diplomatic consonants for display
initial_units.original_source: Compare DJD X / Leon Levy 1QIsaᵃ facsimile
initial_units.english: A voice says, "Cry out!" One said, "What shall I cry?" "All flesh is like grass, and all its glory is like the flower of the field. The grass withers, the flower fades, because Yahweh's breath blows on it. Surely the people are grass."

1qisaa.attribution: Hebrew display consonants for the shown locus; compare Leon Levy DSS Digital Library plates. English: WEB (PD). Not a BHQ apparatus reuse.

11qpsa.source: Hand-curated seed + PD facsimile diplomatic excerpts

initial_units.original: שיר למעלות אשא עיני אל ההרים מני יבוא עזרי
initial_units.original_label: Hebrew of column XIX opening (Song of Ascents) — consonantal display
initial_units.original_source: LOC Scrolls exhibition transcription; compare Sanders DJD IV
initial_units.english: I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

initial_units.original: עזרי מעם יהוה עשה שמים וארץ אל יתן למוט רגלך אל ינום שמרך
initial_units.english: My help comes from Yahweh, who made heaven and earth. He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

11qpsa.attribution: Hebrew display consonants for the shown locus; compare Leon Levy DSS Digital Library plates. English: WEB (PD). Not a BHQ apparatus reuse.

4qsama.source: Hand-curated seed + PD facsimile diplomatic excerpts

initial_units.original: יהוה יחתו מריביו עליו בשמים ירעם יהוה ידין אפסי ארץ ויתן עוז למלכו וירם קרן משיחו
initial_units.original_label: Hebrew of Hannah's song closing (display consonants; 4QSamᵃ differs from MT in places)
initial_units.original_source: Compare Ulrich, DJD XVII — diplomatic edition
initial_units.english: Those who strive with Yahweh shall be broken to pieces. He will thunder against them in the sky. Yahweh will judge the ends of the earth. He will give strength to his king, and exalt the horn of his anointed.
initial_units.english_source: World English Bible (PD); 4QSamᵃ contains longer text in some witnesses

initial_units.original: ויאמר אלהים אל משה אהיה אשר אהיה ויאמר כה תאמר לבני ישראל אהיה שלחני אליכם
initial_units.original_label: Standard Hebrew of the theophany formula (compare 2Q18 surviving letters on Leon Levy plate)

initial_units.english: God said to Moses, "I AM WHO I AM," and he said, "You shall tell the children of Israel this: 'I AM has sent me to you.'"

p-ryl-458.source: Hand-curated seed + PD facsimile diplomatic excerpts

initial_units.original: σὴμερον κύριον τὸν θεὸν σοῦ εἶναι ἐν ὁδοῖς αὐτοῦ πορεύεσθαι καὶ φυλάσσειν τὰ δικαιώματα αὐτοῦ καὶ τὰς ἐντολὰς καὶ τὰ κρίματα αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀκούειν τῆς φωνῆς αὐτοῦ
initial_units.original_label: Greek uncial excerpt (fragment g) — Roberts 1936 diplomatic
initial_units.original_source: C. H. Roberts, P.Ryl. III 458 (1936) — PD editio princeps
initial_units.english: You have declared today that Yahweh is your God, and that you will walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.
initial_units.english_source: World English Bible (PD), adapted from LXX sense

p-ryl-458.attribution: Greek diplomatic excerpts from PD editio princeps plates where noted. English: WEB (PD). Not a Rahlfs/Göttingen apparatus dump.

initial_units.original_label: Greek excerpt; divine name written as Hebrew יהוה in manuscript (see plate)
initial_units.english: Assemble yourselves to me, and I will tell you all that will happen to you in the latter days.

initial_units.original: καὶ οὐ μισήσεις τὸν ἀδελφόν σου τῇ διανοίᾳ σου ἐλέγξεις τὸν πλησίον σου καὶ οὐ λήμψῃ διʼ αὐτὸν ἁμαρτίαν
